summary: MatchEngine.Copy is now a contract-driven deep cloner (StateCloner.cs) that reads System.Text.Json's resolved contract per type and falls back to the JSON round trip for anything it does not understand. Engine copy is ~6-7x faster and Execute ~2.1x faster (3.1 to 1.5 ms/command). Lockstep tests compare it with the JSON copy at every step of seeded games, fixtures and all card definitions, plus independence and replay checks; three mutation checks were caught. Built by an Opus 5.5 subagent.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passed (agent worktree and merged tree)
